notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-link-lengths, CASUB entered directly (the #7426 pattern): the callee a LINK reaches, run as the root program so its own coverage is measured (a LINKed callee is capped at L2, #4270). The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub.

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the callee writes the NO COMMAREA trace and returns without touching DFHCOMMAREA

scenarios.name: short-100
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 100 (< 500): reply stamped, return code 04, the extension left alone

scenarios.name: full-500
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 500: the extension flag and data written, return code 00
